national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 2:03 PM Har Ghar Tiranga campaign begins with multiple events across country to celebrate patriotism and national unity The Har Ghar Tiranga campaign is being celebrated nationwide to foster a sense of patriotism among citizens, strengthen national unity, and promote India’s cultural heritage. The campaign marks the fifth year of the Har Ghar Tiranga initiative, which began in 2022 and has since evolved into one of the country’s largest public participation movements. The initiative is aimed at encouraging citizens to hoist the National Flag and participate in activities celebrating patriotism, national unity and India’s cultural heritage. This year’s campaign holds special significance as it coincides with the 150th anniversary of India’s National Song, “Vande Mataram,” bringing together the National Flag and the National Song in a unique celebration of patriotism. As part of the celebrations, mass singing of Vande Mataram will be organised across the country. In Delhi, as part of the campaign, Lok Sabha BJP MP Bansuri Swaraj paid floral tribute at the memorial of Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya in Malviya Nagar followed by a Tiranga Yatra from Pilanji Village to Greater Kailash. Speaking to the media, Ms Swaraj said that this Independence Day is particularly special as India marks its 80th. She added that the BJP has launched a week-long campaign starting today, during which party office-bearers and workers will visit the memorials of national heroes and martyrs. national_raw_news.title: 26 mins ago | National 85 Home Minister Amit Shah says, 3 new criminal laws are aimed at providing time-bound justice throu...
national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 2:01 PM Home Minister Amit Shah says, 3 new criminal laws are aimed at providing time-bound justice through technology driven mechanism Union Home Minister Amit Shah said that the three new criminal laws introduced by the Modi Government, replacing the colonial-era laws, are based on three important pillars – technology, timeline and trust. Mr Shah said the objective of the new criminal laws is to ensure justice to citizens through a system that is more technology-driven and time-bound. The Home Minister was participating in the presentation ceremony of the President’s Police Colour to the Puducherry Police at the Police Training School ground in Gorimedu. Later today, he will flag off a Har Ghar Tiranga Yatra at Muruga Theatre Signal in Puducherry. Congratulating the Puducherry Police, Mr. Amit Shah said that receiving the President’s Police Colour is one of the most glorious moments in the life of any disciplined police force. He said that although the Puducherry Police has a strength of less than 5,000 personnel, it is entrusted with protecting Puducherry, maintaining its internal security and safeguarding the honour and dignity of the Union Territory, which has a rich spiritual heritage. With this historic recognition of the President’s Police Colour, Puducherry has become the 18th State/Union Territory in the country to be bestowed with this highest honour conferred upon a police force. Puducherry Lieutenant Governor K. Kailashnathan, Chief Minister N. Rangasamy, Home Minister A. Namassivayam and Director General of Police Shalini Singh were also present on the occasion. national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 1:50 PM NIA arrests one more accused in connection with seizure of huge consignment of illegal explosives in Malappuram, Keralam The National Investigation Agency (NIA) has arrested another accused in connection with the seizure of a huge consignment of illegal explosives in Malappuram, Keralam. The Agency informed that the accused was arrested yesterday from Manjeri in the Malappuram district. NIA said that the accused is a main conspirator and was involved in the illegal procurement of the explosives seized in the case. The latest arrest comes a day after the NIA arrested three more accused from Vijayapura in Karnataka on Friday, taking the total number of arrests in the case to ten. The case relates to the seizure of 89,600 explosive sticks and 10,500 shock tubes from a lorry parked in the compound of Farha Hollow Bricks Company on the Chemmad-Thalappara Road in Malappuram. NIA further said that investigation into the larger conspiracy and the illegal procurement and movement of the explosives is continuing. national_raw_news.title: 40 mins ago | International 103 China: Over 1,300 flights cancelled and 3 lakh people relocated ahead of Typhoon Dolphin
national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 1:46 PM China: Over 1,300 flights cancelled and 3 lakh people relocated ahead of Typhoon Dolphin In China, Shanghai’s two airports cancelled more than 1,300 flights and authorities relocated over 3 lakh people in surrounding regions as the country prepared for Typhoon Dolphin. The outer bands of the storm hit northern Taiwan yesterday, including the capital Taipei, bringing rain. Some Taiwanese airlines also cancelled their flights to China. The storm’s maximum sustained winds were estimated at about 162 kilometres per hour as of today morning. It is bringing heavy rains, creating a risk of severe flooding as well as landslides and is expected to hit Zhejiang province and northern parts of neighbouring Fujian province. Authorities are warning of severe landslide risks in Zhejiang. Shanghai’s Hongqiao and Pudong airports also cancelled about 60 per cent of expected flights. Authorities in Zhejiang evacuated some 3 lakh 90 thousand people in the city of Taizhou yesterday. national_raw_news.title: Vice President hoists National Flag in Andaman and Nicobar Islands as part of ‘Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign’
national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 2:19 PM Vice President hoists National Flag in Andaman and Nicobar Islands as part of ‘Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign’ Vice President C. P. Radhakrishnan today hoisted the National Flag at the Flag Point in Sri Vijaya Puram, the capital of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, as part of the ‘Har Ghar Tiranga Campaign’. On the occasion, he paid tribute to the brave freedom fighters. The Vice President also attended the state function, ‘Tiranga Concert on Vande Mataram’, held at the auditorium of Dr B. R. Ambedkar Institute of Technology. In his address, the Vice President recalled the glorious history of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands associated with India’s freedom struggle. He said this is the very land where freedom fighters endured severe torture and unimaginable hardships for the country’s independence. Referring to the historical significance of the Cellular Jail, Mr Radhakrishnan paid homage to the sacrifices and contributions of the freedom fighters. He also recalled the historic day of 30th December 1943, when Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose hoisted the Tricolour in Port Blair. The Vice President said that whenever the Andaman and Nicobar Islands are mentioned, one not only thinks of their natural beauty and lush greenery but also remembers the spirit of patriotism associated with Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose hoisting the Tricolour here for the first time. Referring to the significance of ‘Vande Mataram’, the Vice President said that the song played an important role in strengthening the spirit of nationalism and unity among the people during the freedom movement. He described the Andaman and Nicobar Islands as a symbol of India’s diversity and unity. He also emphasised the need to maintain a balance between the country’s development and environmental protection. Mr Radhakrishnan is on a two-day visit to the Andaman and Nicobar Islands. Yesterday, he visited the National Memorial Cellular Jail and paid tribute to the brave freedom fighters. He also visited Veer Savarkar’s cell and witnessed the light and sound show organised at the Cellular Jail. national_raw_news.title: Pentagon orders US defense companies to accelerate weapons production and deliveries
national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 10:19 AM Pentagon orders US defense companies to accelerate weapons production and deliveries WASHINGTON, Aug. 2, 2019 (Xinhua) -- The Pentagon is seen from an airplane over Washington D.C., the United States, on July 11, 2018. The United States will fully develop ground-launched conventional missiles after withdrawing from the Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces (INF) Treaty, U.S. Secretary of Defense Mark Esper said Friday. (Xinhua/Liu Jie/IANS) The Pentagon has ordered US defense companies to accelerate weapons production and deliveries as the Iran war has depleted key US munitions stockpiles. The Washington Post reported that Deputy Defense Secretary Steve Feinberg told defense industry leaders in a memo that they have 21 days to submit plans to drive significantly faster, more aggressive delivery schedules and increased production for critical capabilities. The Pentagon has also pursued framework agreements with major defense contractors and technology firms to expand production. But those agreements are nonbinding and depend on congressional funding. The directive comes as the Pentagon seeks to replenish stocks of weapons, including Patriot and Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) interceptors. The Center for Strategic and International Studies said the global inventory of Patriot missiles had fallen from about 2,200 before the war to fewer than 827, while THAAD stocks dropped from 452 to less than 278. The Pentagon’s push comes as a 1.15 trillion US Dollar defense spending bill remains stalled in Congress, potentially delaying efforts to rapidly expand weapons production. national_raw_news.title: Ashmita Chaliha clinches her 1st BWF world tour title at Korea Masters 2026 42 mins ago 175
national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 2:10 PM Ashmita Chaliha clinches her 1st BWF world tour title at Korea Masters 2026 Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha produced a superb comeback to win the Korea Masters 2026, beating China’s Han Qian Xi in the women’s singles final this morning. The Assam shuttler recovered from losing the opening game to prevail 14-21, 21-14, and 21-14 in 53 minutes and claim her first BWF title. Earlier, Ashmita reached the final after defeating fellow Indian Rakshitha Ramraj 21-13, 16-21, 21-13 in the semifinal yesterday. While Han outplayed South Korea’s G Kim 22-20, 18-21, and 21-14 in the other semifinal to advance to the final. Ashmita Chaliha had won the gold medal at the 2024 Asia Team Championships. At the 2019 South Asian Games, she had secured gold medals in both the women’s singles and team events. national_raw_news.title: India’s medal tally rises to 3 at World Athletics Under-20 Championships 1 hour ago 50
national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 12:56 PM India’s medal tally rises to 3 at World Athletics Under-20 Championships India’s medal tally rises to three at the World Athletics Under-20 Championships in the United States. India’s Basant Kumar Meghwal wins a silver in the high jump, while Shahnavaz Khan wins a bronze in the long jump today. In the men’s high jump, 19-year-old Meghwal cleared his personal best of 2.21 metres to win a silver medal. He became the first Indian to win a medal in the high jump at the World U-20 Championships. Algeria’s Younes Ayachi won the gold, while Great Britain’s Otis Poole took the bronze. In the men’s long jump, Shahnavaz clinched bronze with a best effort of 7.84 metres. The 18-year-old produced his best jump in his third attempt. Italy’s Daniele Inzoli won the gold medal with a jump of 7.97 metres, while Australia’s Mason McGroder took silver with a personal best of 7.96 metres. Earlier, in the javelin throw, Ashish Yadav won silver and became the second Indian after Neeraj Chopra to win at the World Athletics U20 Championships. Yadav produced his best throw of 74.09 metres in the third round yesterday. national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 9, 2026 8:35 AM Sagnik-Sayantan win Gold medal in Under-31 Pairs at 9th World Bridge Federation Youth Transnational Championships Sagnik Roy and Sayantan Kushari won the gold medal in the Under-31 Pairs at the 9th World Youth Transnational Championships in Hefei, China, yesterday. In the first elimination round, 34 pairs competed and the top 14 advanced to Flight A, including the Indian duo. They then competed in a round-robin format, with Sagnik and Sayantan finishing on top with 377.67 match points. M Fereneca and F Katusich of Croatia finished second with 357.78 match points, while China’s J Han and Z Wang took the third spot with 335.92 match points. national_raw_news.title: Asian Junior Weightlifting C’ships: India Secures Gold, Silver in Men’s 60kg Category 08 Aug 2026 | 9:40 PM 144
national_raw_news.content: News On AIR | August 8, 2026 9:40 PM Asian Junior Weightlifting C’ships: India Secures Gold, Silver in Men’s 60kg Category Indian lifters continued their impressive performance at the Asian Junior Weightlifting Championships in Tashkent, Uzbekistan, today, with a gold and a silver medal in the men’s junior 60-kilogram category. Tomchou Meetei won a total of three medals – gold in the overall category, bronze in the snatch and silver in the clean and jerk. He finished with a combined lift of 266 kilograms. Gurunaidu Sanapathi bagged two medals – silver in the overall category and silver in the snatch, along with bronze in the clean and jerk. He finished with a total lift of 265 kilograms. The two Indian lifters finished just one kilogram apart in the overall standings, giving India a one-two finish in the category.
